content.title: The URL Can Be State
content.hook: Earlier, you learned that a component can hold state.
content.context:
Now add another possibility:

**Some state belongs in the URL.**

For example:

```text
/products?sort=price
```

The URL tells the application which sort view is active.

Or:

```text
/products/42
```

The path identifies which product is being viewed.
goals: Recognize when information belongs in the URL because it describes where the user is or what view they are looking at.

content.question:
A user filters a product list by `?category=books` and then copies the URL to a friend.

Why is putting the filter in the URL useful?

options.text: It makes the filter impossible to change.
The URL can represent the current view, so another person can open the same location.
It automatically stores every future filter forever.
It removes the need for any UI.

feedback.correct: URL state is useful when the state describes a shareable or navigable view.
feedback.incorrect: URL state is useful when the state describes a shareable or navigable view.

content.title: Path vs query
content.text:
Compare:

```text
/products/42
/products?sort=price
```

A useful beginner model is:

- the **path** often identifies the resource or screen location;
- the **query string** often describes options for that view.

This is a model, not a universal law. The important skill is recognizing information that belongs to the location itself.

content.question: Which value is a strong candidate for the URL?

options.text: Whether a temporary tooltip is fading out.
Which product detail page the user is viewing.

feedback.correct: The selected product is part of the application location. The other examples are temporary local behavior.
feedback.incorrect: The selected product is part of the application location. The other examples are temporary local behavior.

content.question:
A user opens:

```text
/search?q=keyboard
```

They refresh the page.

What should a well-designed application be able to infer again?

options.text: The exact animation frame the input had before refresh.
The internal state of every component.

feedback.correct: The URL survives a refresh. That makes it useful for state that describes the current view.
feedback.incorrect: The URL survives a refresh. That makes it useful for state that describes the current view.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** The URL is not just an address. It can be part of the application's state model.
**Senior habit:** When someone says “users should be able to refresh, bookmark, share, or return to this view,” consider whether the important state belongs in the URL.
